items.description: Maniac: Hunt or Be Hunted is a thrilling first-person multiplayer horror experience where one player takes on the role of a ruthless maniac, while the others must cooperate, complete objectives, and fight to survive. The game is steeped in tension, where every death could be your last. The game takes place in an abandoned village surrounded by a dense forest, where all the residents mysteriously vanished, leaving behind empty homes and eerie remnants. With each passing day, the atmosphere grows darker, and the nights become unbearable. Every night is a new test of survival, as an unknown killer lurks somewhere in the shadows, ready to strike at any moment. Who will become the Maniac, and who will survive the night? The choice is yours. Players are thrown into random locations with a single goal — survive. The Maniac and survivors play as distinct characters, adding unexpected twists to every match. While the Maniac hunts and eliminates the survivors, the others must work together to outsmart, trap, or defeat the killer using scattered items and improvised tactics. A carefully designed survival system offers a range of interactive elements: search for weapons, set traps, or quietly sneak through the darkness. But the key to survival is trust — and knowing when to rely on your team. Key Features:Asymmetric multiplayer gameplay: one player (the room creator) becomes the Maniac with unique abilities, while the others must cooperate to stay alive.Deep, immersive atmosphere: realistic sound design and haunting environments constantly keep players on edge.Multiple tactical choices: survivors can pick up weapons, set traps, use distractions, or psychologically outplay one another.Special abilities for the Maniac:Highlight all survivors temporarily, allowing the Maniac to see every player’s location and plan a deadly ambush.Fear system — victims entering certain conditions (like hearing footsteps, finding corpses, or being left alone) will panic, making more noise and becoming easier to track. items.description: With a mix of twisted puzzles, brain-teasing quizzes, and mind-bending mini-games, The Test of Insanity will test the very limits of your brain. Whether you’re a genius or an influencer, a billionaire or the person they just fired, whoever you are, you can be sure of one thing: The Test of Insanity will challenge your mind to the core, in ways you’ve never been challenged before. These puzzles may seem easy at a glance, but the answers may not be what you're thinking. However, solving these puzzle can also be quite satisfying. If you like puzzle games, mind twisters, or weird games, this game is for you. Featuring: ⭐ Not so traditional math problems ⭐ Weird word puzzles ⭐ Trivia of not obvious stuff ⭐ Skill tests that are incredibly difficult ⭐ Cute squirrels ⭐ And more things that make you go nuts... From math problems and word puzzles to trivia and skill tests, this puzzle game offers a diverse range of brain challenges that will keep you hooked. Inspired by the infamous Impossible Quiz, our game requires you to think outside the box and embrace the ridiculous. Question is: How far will you go before going insane? Many don’t pass level 1.
